description: This source file defines the SwiftUI view 'VoiceWakeOverlayView', which provides an overlay interface for voice wake functionality. It manages UI elements such as text editing, a send button with progress indication, and close controls, interacting with a 'VoiceWakeOverlayController' to handle user actions and state.
